claims.text: Aragorn's name is Sindarin, and means "Revered King", from ara, a prefix for royalty, and gorn "revered".
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, "Words, Phrases and Passages in Various Tongues in The Lord of the Rings", in Parma Eldalamberon XVII (edited by Christopher Gilson)

claims.text: Indeed, after having ruled as Chieftain for only eight years, his life was cut short in , when he was killed by savage wolves in Eriador (which were always a peril in that land). He was succeeded by his son Araglas.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "The Númenorean Kings", "The Realms in Exile", "The Northern Line: Heirs of Isildur"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "The Númenorean Kings", "Eriador, Arnor, and the Heirs of Isildur"
